rules.sentence: A distinction should be made between stable ischemic heart disease and acute coronary syndrome (ACS), in which a more acute presentation with troponin elevation (i.e., myocardial infarction) or high-risk chest pain without troponin elevation (ie, high-risk UA) is required for the diagnosis.

A distinction should be made between stable ischemic heart disease and acute coronary syndrome (ACS), in which a more acute presentation with troponin elevation (i.e., myocardial infarction) or high-risk chest pain without troponin elevation (ie, high-risk UA) is required for the diagnosis.

It also bears mentioning that stable ischemic heart disease patients can develop chronic, slow worsening of their angina symptoms, which is often managed medically, or may go on to develop ACS and require urgent intervention.
